card.name: Last digit of a number, before a boundary
card.fires_on: The final digit of a multi-digit number (year, patient count) just before a closing bracket, dash or 'of patients' phrase. Also 'minute' at the end of 'mL/minute'.

modes.label: Final digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a year or patient count, right before the number ends.

modes.label: Unit word minute
modes.description: The word 'minute' closing a rate unit such as mL/minute in a dosing threshold.
modes.example: creatinine clearance of 45 mL/<<minute>> or greater is 500 mg

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a long number, such as a year or a trial patient count, just before the number ends.
